provenance.api: public kernelFactories CRT adapter + bindCanonicalKernel + runPass + Surface
provenance.reference_only: expected outputs come from the pinned public CPU CRT adapter; raw canonical and counted factory mutations are diagnostics only

input.construction: asymmetric top-down Float32Array formula shared with Task21; alpha deliberately outside [0,1]

fixture.verification: fresh double render, exact F32/RGBA8 repeat, finite lanes, input alpha preservation

mutation_sensitivity.purpose: locks public adapter, shadowed symbols, alpha return/mix, render/tile/full coordinates, scanline parity, channel order, hue/saturation/vignette/contrast, seed, and F32 association

mutations.name: public-metal-sine-disabled
mutations.contract: uses raw canonical Math.sin instead of required public CRT reduced-turn sine adapter

mutations.name: uniform-time-local-alias-offset
mutations.contract: perturbs only the shadow-safe local time copy

mutations.name: uniform-speed-local-alias-offset
mutations.contract: perturbs only the shadow-safe local speed copy

mutations.name: output-alpha-uses-uniform-not-shadowed-input
mutations.contract: writes uniform alpha instead of base_sample alpha, exposing local alpha shadow identity

mutations.name: uniform-alpha-clamp-disabled
mutations.contract: uses raw uniform alpha for the early return and final mix

mutations.name: render-scale-clamp-disabled
mutations.contract: uses raw renderScale for scaled dimensions instead of max(renderScale,1)

mutations.name: full-resolution-fallback-disabled
mutations.contract: selects zero fullResolution instead of resolution at x equals zero

mutations.name: shape-frequency-axes-unswapped
mutations.contract: uses same-axis frequency instead of canonical cross-axis mapping

replacements.from:
var freq_x = max(freq[1], 1);
  	var freq_y = max(freq[0], 1);
replacements.to:
var freq_x = max(freq[0], 1);
  	var freq_y = max(freq[1], 1);

mutations.name: red-tile-local-subtraction-disabled
mutations.contract: uses red global x directly as local texture x

mutations.name: blue-tile-local-subtraction-disabled
mutations.contract: uses blue global x directly as local texture x

mutations.name: red-channel-assembly-uses-blue
mutations.contract: assembles output red from blue_blended rather than red_blended

mutations.name: restore-hue-disabled
mutations.contract: removes the post-assembly negative hue restoration

mutations.name: vignette-alpha-forced-zero
mutations.contract: retains vignette calls but forces their blend strength to zero

mutations.name: effect-color-8bit-quantization-disabled
mutations.contract: uses unquantized effect color in the final mix

mutations.name: seed-base-disabled
mutations.contract: removes integer seed from chromatic and vignette random controls
